generationInputs.prompt: A minimalist Mexican apartment kitchen features three individuals: a young woman taking a selfie, a middle-aged woman seated at a desk, and a man looking off to the side near a microphone. In the foreground, a young woman with light-toned skin, light blue eyes, and long, wavy, platinum blonde hair wearing round, thin-rimmed glasses and bright red lipstick takes a close-up selfie; she is adorned with a delicate gold necklace with a dark red heart pendant and a thin, dark red choker, and wears a black top with a hint of red underneath. To her side, a fair-skinned middle-aged woman with shoulder-length gray hair and light-colored framed glasses sits at a light-colored desk, wearing a dark teal button-up shirt under a light beige cardigan with dark circular patterns and a gold-toned watch, her hands clasped over a piece of white paper near a closed white notebook with a black spiral binding and a pen. Nearby, a fair-skinned man with dark brown hair, a sparse goatee, and black-framed rectangular glasses, dressed in a light blue collared shirt under a light-colored suit jacket, gazes to the right next to a microphone on a light gray or silver stand with a round metallic head. The minimalist kitchen setting includes simple countertops and cabinets, suggesting a clean and uncluttered space.
